Datadog is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for its CI/CD Security team within the SDLC Security organization, building a new security layer for the company's continuous integration and delivery infrastructure. The work centers on trusted build provenance, secure secret delivery, and real-time policy enforcement at the network layer, all operating in the critical path of software delivery under high throughput and low latency constraints. The core stack involves a modern language such as Go, Python, Rust, Java, or JavaScript, along with CI/CD architecture, cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure.
